facts.business: Karma Energy Limited generates and sells wind power to state utilities in India.
key_risks: Considerable delay in processing or decision making by state utilities and State Electricity Regulatory Commission and higher judicial authorities resulting in strain on sustainability of small wind farms

Inordinate delays in adjudication of matters by Electricity Regulatory Commission, Appellate Tribunal for Electricity and High Courts resulting in acute pressure due to huge mismatch in inflow and outflow of funds
Higher Operation and Maintenance Costs and repairs to wind mills at different sites affecting margins
Erratic payments from state utilities where the company sells power
